title: Professional Development Certificates (TS9-TS10)
journeyNote: Growing as a teacher did not only happen in the classroom. These are the times I stepped outside it to learn.
overview: Professional development milestones, external pedagogical webinars, and direct classroom instructional assistance.

ts9.title: Learnings from the Professional Webinar
ts9.speaker: Andy
ts9.organizer: Mike Cabigon (Head of Market, English and Exams)
ts9.quote: Assessment is not just about measuring learning, but empowering it.
ts9.reaction: This reminded me that assessment is not a last step but part of the lesson from the start.
topLearnings: Good assessment measures what you actually taught, which is alignment, and it links directly to my TS2 and TS3.
Feedback is part of assessment, because it tells learners what to improve next.
Fair assessment uses clear criteria, so every learner is judged by the same standard.
ts9.applicationInClass: Learning 1. I already learned how much alignment matters, and the webinar gave me the language to explain why.

ts10.title: School Activity Participation
ts10.heading: What I did to support my Cooperating Teacher:
activities: Checked papers, recorded scores, and tracked attendance.
Taught 2 sections every Wednesday and Thursday: wrote the lesson plans, crafted the instructional materials, and facilitated quizzes and activities.
Served as observer for 3 other sections.
ts10.mentoringNote: My CT's comments are in my Weekly Mentoring Forms (Appendices).
